corrections.why: Four sources give a 10-foot tower (about 3.0 m). Only an undated inventory, quoted by Forest Lookouts, gives 20 feet (6.1 m).
The site moved to Nez Perce National Forest in 1957, after the tower was destroyed in 1951. Bitterroot is correct only for the earlier period.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Most sources (firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts citing Kresek, and the Forest Service list) give 1932 for a 10-foot L-4 tower. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1934 for the cab on a 10-foot tower. An undated inventory, quoted by Forest Lookouts, gives 1931 for a 20-foot tower. The story reports 1932 as the majority date and notes the others.

The Forest Service list calls the site Battle Ridge, while Forest Lookouts calls it Battle Creek (ridge). Both give Township 33 North, Range 14 East, Section 10 and a position 12 miles from Moose Creek, so they describe the same lookout.

notes_for_editor: Dates and height conflict across sources; the story reports the majority and says sources disagree. The brief's height (6.1 m, 20 ft) and agency (Bitterroot) are proposed corrections above. The brief's coordinates conflict: ffla 46.21065, -114.6865 matches firelookout.org, while west_us_lookouts 46.21131, -114.62732 is about 4.5 km east. Not resolved here, and the story uses no coordinates. No staffing source, so staffing is omitted. No source describes what remains on the ridge.
